notes: Executed manually by the repo author following the personal-apd loop (plan -> build -> 3 reviewers -> fix -> re-verify). Verification actually performed: `npm run build` (tsc -b strict + vite build) clean on round 1 and round 2; markdown renderer smoke-tested via node (code-span protection, HTML escaping, javascript: URL rejection, unclosed fence). Not verified: real browser interaction, localStorage round-trip across reloads (code-reviewed only). Suggested but not done (reviewer info finding): add a vitest suite for the markdown renderer.

findings.message: Emphasis markers inside inline code spans were processed: `*x*` rendered as <em> inside <code>.
findings.suggestion: Protect code spans with placeholders before applying emphasis/link rules.

findings.message: Tags input reformatted while typing: a trailing comma was stripped immediately because the input was bound to the parsed tag list.
findings.suggestion: Keep local text state for the input; commit parsed tags on change; resync only when switching notes.

findings.message: parseTags() lived in ids.ts, which is about id generation - wrong module, hurts discoverability.
dangerouslySetInnerHTML usage audited: safe - renderer HTML-escapes input before applying markup and restricts links to http(s). No finding; recording the check.
On reload with saved notes, no note is selected - the user lands on an empty pane instead of their most recent note.
findings.suggestion: Extend the selection-repair effect to auto-select the newest note when selection is null.

findings.message: Renderer has no automated tests; edge cases (nested markup, unclosed fences) are only manually verified.
findings.suggestion: Add a vitest suite for renderMarkdown. Not implemented in this run - recorded as future work.

task: Build a markdown notes app (React + TypeScript + Vite): create/edit/delete notes, markdown preview, search, tags, localStorage persistence.

tokens.note: No LLM API calls; the loop was executed manually by the author.
